searchText: <@!628018527470616606> Great work! Teku is up-to-date with spec, but still in testing against the updated Catalyst, latest work is here: https://github.com/ConsenSys/teku/compare/master...txrx-research:rayonism-merge Mikhail and me will be working on the devnet setup next week, we have the setup with keystores + custom eth1/eth2 configuration working, but need to document running of the clients more + test deposits. See https://notes.ethereum.org/@protolambda/merge-devnet-setup-guide for info how to configure one yourself. Prysm is working on updating to latest spec as well, and you may be able to run that later next week. <sigpaul> Lighthouse is also working on it, we expect to have a working version next week. We only have WSL support at the moment, though. WSL = windows subsystem for linux? <sigpaul> Yep :) Office-hour update; I'm dropping the sydney-focused timeslot, to just schedule calls with folks in that timezone directly (not as many, basically Lighthouse + maybe Adrian from Teku). Updated time table: ``` | PT (-7) | UTC | CET (+2) | AEST (+10) | | 10:00 Mon | 17:00 Mon April 19 | 19:00 Mon | 03:00 Tue | | 02:00 Fri | 09:00 Fri April 23 | 11:00 Fri | 19:00 Fri | (repeat every week) ``` I don’t think i provide any benefit on a call but happy to be pulled in anytime you think I can be helpful. Amazing work!
